Tara (CSM): Quick heads-up 10-day runway-sprint-save proposal for NorthBridge (enterprise, ~95 seats). Usage dropped ~38% last 30d, renewal in 24 days. I want a targeted sprint: 48h infra trial + tailored enablement + temporary downgrade window. Keep it as a short runway, not a permanent concession. Thoughts? :slightly_smiling_face:

Ilya (CS Ops): Health signal flagged low active users and stuck onboarding tasks at step 3. I can export the task completion funnel and share heatmap. Link: https://go.redwood/nb-heatmap :mag_right:

Noah (AE): I can run an executive reset call Fri 11am PT. Need a clear metric to promise (ex: latency improvement or token % reduction) to justify the downgrade window.

Priya (SE): Their Dedicated cluster shows KV/prefix cache off and conservative batching. Quick experiment plan: enable cache on canary pool, increase batch cap, and measure 48h delta on token spend and 95th latency. If token spend reduces >18% we have strong renewal ammunition.

Priya (SE): ```
Canary steps:
- enable prefix_cache=true on gpool-3
- set max_batch_tokens=4096 for chat endpoints
- monitor: 95p latency, median latency, tokens/session
- rollback: rb_cache_toggle.sh if regressions
```

Omar (Product): If they can surface 4 representative failing prompts or sessions, we'll repro in staging and check for reranker/model mismatch. Also want a short post-session survey to capture whether enablement addressed friction.

Tara (CSM): Proposed 10-day runway-sprint-save plan:
- Day 0: Exec reset call + commit to 48h infra trial (Noah/Priya)
- Days 1-4: Two 45-min tailored enablement labs for top user groups (Priya/Tara)
